summary_for_children: As-Saff means The Ranks. It tells us to do what we say, praises believers united like a solid structure, and mentions Isa's disciples as supporters of Allah.
environment_concept: A wall of tightly joined stones (61:4).
architecture_and_scenery: Stone wall building site, a field.

areas.name: Firm Structure
areas.description: A wall of tightly joined stones.

activities.description: Carry six stones to build one firm wall.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: An orchard on a slope behind an old stone wall with a fallen stretch and stones lying ready

primary_mechanic.text: Rebuild the fallen stretch of wall course by course with long and short stones; a stone that would put a joint right above a joint in the course below is refused, then push the finished wall and it holds as one (61:4, a picture of “a structure joined firmly”).

secondary_activities: why say what you do not do (61:2-3, read)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the path, the wall, then two readings in the orchard
world_assets: old stone wall with a fallen stretch
environment_behaviour: each course appears on the wall as it is laid
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that saying without doing is hated by Allah (61:2-3) and the image of a structure joined firmly (61:4)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Standing Together
story_library.children_narration: Surah As-Saff reminds us that our words and actions should agree. If we promise something good, we should try our best to do it. It also recalls Isa's message and encourages believers to support truth.

world_idea.title: The Workshop of Commitment
world_idea.description: Children work with a team of friendly fictional characters to complete a shared community project, learning that cooperation requires keeping promises.
